title: Place value and rounding
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review
about: Teacher-verified mastery check. Written separately from the practice generators: different wordings, word problems, and an 'is this right?' item. Each item is worth 1 point. 'math' is the answer in JavaScript form (a number, or a sign '<' '>' '=' as text, or the chosen number); the test checks the answer key against it.

items.prompt: What is the value of the 7 in 372,915?
The 3 in 3,000 is how many times the value of the 3 in 30?
A stadium holds 48,652 people. About how many is that, to the nearest thousand?
Theo rounded 7,960 to the nearest hundred and got 7,900. Is he right? Explain, and round it.
items.answer: 8,000 (No: the 6 tells you to round up)

items.prompt: What is the value of the 4 in 841,067?
The 5 in 50,000 is how many times the value of the 5 in 500?
A town has 9,738 people. About how many is that, to the nearest hundred?
Ava says the 2 in 32,618 is worth 2. Is she right? Explain, and give its value.
